description: This source file defines the ChartRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering chart objects into RTF format within the MigraDoc library. It includes methods for rendering images of charts into RTF, handling image attributes, scaling, and inserting image byte data, as well as managing rendering contexts and warnings.

classes.name: ChartRenderer
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for rendering Chart objects into RTF format.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the chart as an image into RTF, managing temporary files and context placement.

methods.name: RenderImage
methods.description: Handles rendering image-specific attributes and the image byte stream into RTF.

methods.name: StartImageDescription
methods.description: Initializes RTF content for image description, handling inline and block images.

methods.name: EndImageDescription
methods.description: Closes RTF tags for image description.

methods.name: RenderImageAttributes
methods.description: Renders attributes such as shape type, fill, and dimensions for the image.

methods.name: RenderSourceType
methods.description: Specifies the image source type for RTF (e.g., PNG).

methods.name: RenderDimensionSettings
methods.description: Sets scaling, width, and height parameters for the image in RTF units.

methods.name: StoreTempImage
methods.description: Creates a bitmap of the chart, saves it as a PNG file in a temporary location, or returns false if unsupported.

methods.name: RenderByteSeries
methods.description: Reads the image file byte-by-byte and writes it in hexadecimal form to the RTF writer.

methods.name: GetShapeHeight
methods.description: Overrides to include line width in the shape height.

methods.name: GetShapeWidth
methods.description: Overrides to include line width in the shape width.

fields.name: _isInline
fields.description: Boolean indicating if the chart is inline or positioned in block context.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to produce RTF output for the chart.

methods.name: RenderImage
methods.description: Responsible for image data and attribute rendering.
